2: (() => {

21:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h);
22:       ctx.closePath();
23:       ctx.fill();
24:     }
25:   };

27:   // Input handling
28:   const keys = {};
29:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
31: 
32:   // Asteroids
33:   const asteroids = [];
34:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
35:   let lastSpawn = 0;
36:   const maxSize = 30;
37: 
38:   function spawnAsteroid() {
39:     const size = Math.random() * maxSize + 10;
40:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
41:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
42:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed });
43:   }
44: 
45:   // Collision detection
46:   function rectCircleCollide(rect, circle) {
47:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x + circle.r - (rect.x + rect.w / 2));
48:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y + circle.r - (rect.y + rect.h / 2));
49:     if (distX > rect.w / 2 + circle.r) return false;
50:     if (distY > rect.h / 2 + circle.r) return false;
51:     if (distX <= rect.w / 2) return true;
52:     if (distY <= rect.h / 2) return true;
53:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
54:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
55:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= circle.r * circle.r;
56:   }
